items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: And Alan Connery, that time he was upstairs with George McCubbin and all that bunch.

ctx.x: I wonder if you mind telling just when you were born, what part of the city? I'm born in New Orleans. I'm born 1907.
What is the exact birth date? My name's birthday, be what ever, Alan? You? My name's birthday.
